name: Figure of two men
dimensions: Height 14 cm; Width 7.5 cm; Depth 6 cm
summary: The industry of ivory carving started in the western part of the Fujian province at Zhangzhou. Many figures produced in the early days of the industry were votive images commissioned for the Spanish market. These images stimulated the production of a large series of figures in Chinese tastes.
